reviews.title: Prepare for staff review
reviews.summary: Check that hosts can edit test content safely, booking tests use independent fixtures, and the test site stays within its Firebase budget.

reviews.title: Verify the full booking journey
reviews.summary: Walk through booking, arrival and checkout in pre-prod. Review emails, invoices and walk-in stays along the way.

reviews.title: Review the website and Living Map
reviews.summary: Review navigation, Google sign-in and the host content workflow on the phones and computers people use.

hrudhi.title: Chat with Hrudhi
hrudhi.summary: A planned English text guide to help website visitors find answers about stays, day visits and the Living Map. The launch date is open.
stages: Agree on public sources, privacy and the operating budget.
Check answer quality, navigation links and Dynatrace telemetry using synthetic questions.
Review the pre-prod evidence before opening chat to website visitors.

releases.title: Clearer feedback at the front desk
releases.summary: Hosts see progress during booking actions and can keep reading the dashboard as it refreshes. Host Studio also supports early checkout.

releases.title: Natura media moves to Firebase Storage
releases.summary: The Natura design pages keep their original links while photos and other media load from Firebase Storage.

releases.title: Aroha branding in Host Studio
releases.summary: Host Studio shows the Aroha Retreat logo and keeps legal links visible at the bottom of the workspace.

releases.title: A dashboard for the day’s work
releases.summary: Studio opens on arrivals, departures and booking requests. Hosts can find guest profiles and review payments, invoices and sent emails. Guests can download issued invoices and receipts.

releases.title: Saved IDs for future check-ins
releases.summary: Guests can keep a newly saved ID photo for use on later visits.

releases.title: Private identity review and guest numbers
releases.summary: Guests can manage private ID photos, and booking managers can review them from active bookings. The release adds guest numbering and improves booking details on smaller screens.

releases.title: A lighter website download
releases.summary: Public retreat media moved to Firebase Storage, reducing the size of the files shipped with the website.

releases.title: Explore the Living Map
releases.summary: The Living Map introduced an illustrated farm route with eleven places to explore and a Reading View.

releases.title: Core library updates
releases.summary: Compatible updates to Firebase, Resend and OpenTelemetry are available on the test site.

releases.title: Review early checkout
releases.summary: Hosts can review an early departure before confirming checkout. The booking records the actual checkout time.

releases.title: Clearer checkout timing
releases.summary: The booking drawer shows when checkout opens and explains why the action is unavailable before that time.
